questions.stem: Why is argon used to fill light bulbs?

options.text: It is cheaper than using a vacuum
It makes the bulb glow brighter
It is unreactive, so it will not react with the hot metal filament

questions.explanation: Argon is used in light bulbs because it is unreactive (inert). If air were used, the oxygen would react with the hot metal filament, causing it to burn out quickly. Argon prevents oxidation, extending the filament's life. Argon is also cheap as it makes up about 1% of air.
